h1: Custom Sublimation Apparel for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom sublimation apparel for your team or event. Vibrant, all-over prints on bulk apparel. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Sublimation printing allows for full-color, all-over designs that won't crack or peel, making it ideal for custom apparel with intricate patterns or photo-quality graphics. From performance shirts like the Vansport™ Pro Maui Shirt to full-color socks and headbands, sublimation delivers vibrant, durable results on polyester fabrics. Perfect for teams, events, or branded merchandise that needs to stand out.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation apparel featuring a full-color printed performance shirt and matching socks
